title: The reclaim launch resolved on spawn, before the Linux program joined its cgroup and dropped root, so a crash could prove an empty cgroup while the old program still ran
resolution: The program writes ready after it joins its cgroup and drops identity, and launch resolves only on that signal or fails as unavailable; host and worker image tests hold the program before its cgroup.

title: The crash tests threw in process and reopened, running the abandon cleanup that a real kill skips, and WS10.after had no recovery case
resolution: Each of the 13 crash points WS5.before to WS10.after now kills a separate worker process by SIGKILL, so no abandon cleanup runs, and a new worker recovers; WS10.after has its own case and tasks.md states the coverage.

title: The Linux test of a program without go used a checkout and a file the execution account could not change, so a program ignoring go would also pass
resolution: The Linux test uses a checkout and a 0600 file the execution account made, a program that ignores go changes it as a control, and the exit code 3 is read from a FIFO for the timeout and the dead worker.

title: The Linux tests took the first process in the cgroup as ready before it dropped root, and the short go window could end before polling saw the program
resolution: The uid checks follow the readiness signal, the timeout case waits for the reported exit code instead of polling a short state, and processesOf skips a process that exits while it is read.

title: The no-secret test scanned only results and data root files, not the captured Git output or the output of prepare, remote read, and push
resolution: The test records the runner's scrubbed output, the worker's stdout and stderr, every Git argv, results, and data root files for prepare, remote read, and push, the push also against the echoing remote.

title: The spec delta did not modify the requirements that record the containment before the program starts, which Q3 relaxed
resolution: MODIFIED Reclaim program containment and Reclaim program on one account record the containment after readiness and before go, with the 60 s bound and the exit when the worker dies; contract step 7 matches.

title: The new host hand-off tests and conformance runs did not bound Git repository discovery, so a .git in an ancestor of TMPDIR changed them
resolution: Not reproduced: no fixture or adapter Git process runs where discovery reaches an ancestor; all 189 host adapter tests pass with the default TMPDIR and with TMPDIR inside a valid Git repository.

title: The hand-off record parser accepted a record without the containment key as one without containment
resolution: The parser requires the containment key and treats only an explicit null as none; a negative parser test covers a record without the key.
